title: The pre-commit reseal holds a proof whose closure the commit does not carry, before running it
intention: The pre-commit reseal runs a proof only when the commit carries everything the proof measures, so a seal and any trouble it raises describe the tree being committed, never uncommitted work beside it.
why: The BUILDME-records commit 4faf4e29 (11cd253f10bc) staged only cairn/tools/base records, and the pre-commit reseal ran every cairn/tools/base proof over the working tree carrying 11cd's uncommitted transitions.py: test_transitions.py ran red, raised seal-red-cairn-tools-base, and 22 base validations were held. A seal and a trouble must describe the tree being committed. Asked for by the peer's foreground call F17 (b) (/home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md line 458), Akien's to overturn.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass — a seal must measure the bytes it is a claim about) and Law 7 (records of truth are permanent: a trouble raised from a red measured over a tree no commit carries is a false entry in a record of truth). Measured: 4faf4e29 staged only cairn/tools/base history.json and state.json; the reseal ran every cairn/tools/base proof over the working tree carrying 11cd's uncommitted transitions.py, ran test_transitions.py red, raised seal-red-cairn-tools-base, and left 22 base validations HELD (F17 (b)).
how: In cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py: the test stage_clean_seals already applies AFTER the run (a seal is staged only when the proof file and every file in its closure carry no unstaged change and nothing untracked) moves BEFORE the run. A proof whose closure is dirty against the index is not run: outcome 'held', no seal written, no trouble raised, the dirty paths named; the commit that carries those files reseals it. cli --reseal --stage prints HELD for it as it prints HELD today. One shared predicate, so the before-run hold and the after-run stage cannot disagree. Questions a Haiku-level builder would need, answered here: Where? cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py and cairn/devices/tester/cli.py only. (A) New module-level function dirty_against_index(proof_rel: str, closure: list[str] | None, base: Path) -> list[str], placed directly above stage_clean_seals: files = list(closure) if closure is not None else [os.path.relpath(component_root_for(str(base / proof_rel)), base)]; files.append(proof_rel); runs the same two git calls stage_clean_seals runs today (git -C base diff --name-only -- *files; git -C base ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- *files) and returns sorted(dirty + untracked). stage_clean_seals calls it in place of its inline calls; its behaviour is otherwise unchanged. (B) reseal() and reseal_all() gain keyword index_only: bool = False; reseal_all passes it through. In reseal(), directly after `if before["proven"]: return {...unchanged...}` and before the raiser is resolved: if index_only, top = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(proof.parent),'rev-parse','--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True); if top.returncode == 0: base = Path(top.stdout.strip()); trail = read_validations(str(proof)); closure = closure_of(trail[-1]) if trail else None; dirty = dirty_against_index(os.path.relpath(proof, base), closure, base); if dirty: return {'proof': rel, 'outcome': 'held', 'rung': 1, 'ran': False, 'because': dirty, 'why': 'the commit does not carry ' + ', '.join(dirty[:3]) + ' — this proof measures what is committed, so it waits for the commit that carries them'}. (C) stage_clean_seals: at the top of its loop, a result whose outcome is 'held' appends {'validation': os.path.relpath(validations_path_for(str(base / r['proof'])), base), 'because': r['because']} to held and continues. (D) cli.py _reseal_run: door.reseal_all(..., index_only=bool(args.stage)). Proof: a new file cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_seal_measures_what_the_commit_carries.py, teeth (1)-(4) as named in the falsifier, PROVES = {<this ticket id>: {'1': ..., '2': ..., '3': ..., '4': ...}}, main via print_teeth_main like test_reseal_stages_clean_seals.py; its fixture is test_reseal_door.py's _component()/_record()/_FakeTester/_FakeRaiser shape inside a scratch_dir that is git init'd with user.email/user.name configured, every git call -C the scratch repo, never the live tree. Its validation record cairn/devices/tester/validations/test_a_seal_measures_what_the_commit_carries.json.

Teeth 1 and 4 red with reseal.py and cli.py reverted to the pre-build commit (the hollow).
